title: Japan Indigo Series
description: This special capsule carries our vision across the Pacific, forging connections with the finest Japanese makers who share in our deep respect for the details, and the pursuit of mastering craft. Partnering with a long-revered manufacturer in Fukuyama, Hiroshima—the heart of Japan’s denim capital—the collection reimagines archetypal baseball silhouettes using premium cotton denim. Each piece is meticulously cut, sewn, dyed, and finished entirely in Japan.
